_note: Our own stories. wire.py reads this list. A story appears on the site ONLY if signed_off_by is filled in and its embargo time (UTC, or null) has passed. kind: story | release. sponsored: true puts a SPONSORED label on every card and in the RSS title. lead: true makes it the homepage lead. Every image needs photo_credit, and its license is recorded in data/image-credits.json.

articles.title: World Newswire Press Launches: A Global Newsroom Built to Give the World a Voice
articles.dek: A new international news site and wire service goes live today, covering five regions of the planet, publishing its own reporting, and opening a Press Room where organizations anywhere can distribute their news.
articles.image_alt: The whole Earth seen from Apollo 17, with Africa, Arabia and Antarctica visible

articles.byline: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press

articles.title: World Court Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya, a First for the ICJ
articles.dek: In a 9-6 decision, the International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for genocide in northern Rakhine State and ordered reparations. Making Myanmar comply is the next fight.
articles.image_alt: Rows of shelters at the Kutupalong refugee camp in Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh
articles.photo_credit: Photo: John Owens / VOA, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
articles.byline: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press

articles.title: Russian Missiles Hit Three Kyiv Bridges Over the Dnipro in a Second Strike on the City's Crossings in a Week
articles.dek: Kyiv's mayor called it the biggest attack yet on the routes that join the two halves of the capital. At least eight people were killed across Ukraine, and the toll was still being counted.
articles.image_alt: The Podilskyi bridge crossing the Dnipro River in Kyiv on a summer day
articles.photo_credit: Photo: Maksym Kozlenko, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons (taken in 2019)
articles.byline: By the World Desk, World Newswire Press

articles.title: COP31 Runs Into Overtime in Antalya as the Words 'Fossil Fuels' Vanish From the Draft Deal
articles.dek: Nearly 200 countries missed Friday's deadline at the UN climate summit in Turkey. The fight is over whether the final text mentions moving away from oil, gas and coal at all.
